stories.title: Céline Dion returns to stage after six years sidelined by rare illness
new_facts: Specifies the hiatus lasted six years; describes crowd reaction (dancing, singing, crying).
Names disorder as stiff person syndrome (SPS), 2022 diagnosis, age 58, muscle spasms broke her ribs.
States residency is 16 shows at Plenitude Arena, and all sold out.
Adds direct quote from Dion telling the crowd it was 'amazing we are all together'.
stories.line: Céline Dion performed her first concert in six years after being sidelined by Stiff Person Syndrome, a rare neurological disorder.

stories.line: Automattic's board attempted to remove CEO Matt Mullenweg this week but reversed course, reinstating him with stated full support.

stories.title: South Australia records first bird flu case in sea lion
new_facts: First bird flu case in a sea lion recorded in South Australia, found at Seal Bay, Kangaroo Island.
stories.line: South Australia confirms bird flu in a sea lion, marking the first detected case in the species in that region.
